description: Builds conditional visibility rules for signing fields.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Fallback culture used when localized labels are missing.

parameters.name: Conditions
parameters.description: Field identifier whose conditions are currently edited.

parameters.name: ConditionsChanged
parameters.description: Condition rules currently assigned to the edited field.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Whether the builder controls are disabled.

parameters.name: CurrentFieldUuid
parameters.description: All fields in the current signing template.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the condition rules change.

parameters.name: FallbackCulture
parameters.description: Culture used to resolve localized field and option labels.
